[[Karn (settler)|Karn's]] '''wife''' joined him in establishing a [[Farm/Legends|farm]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muzara]]<ref name="RKD" /> in [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]].<ref name="CSWE II 346">{{CSWECite|II|346|Muzara}}</ref> Karn and his wife were joined by their daughter, [[Cavvie]], Karn's brother-in-law [[Tallov Kersk]], his [[Tallov Kersk's wife|wife]], and their son, [[Vettle]]. The family became the first settlers from the [[Brentaal League]] to encounter the planet's native [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Muza]].<ref name="RKD" />
